//: Story Phase 2: inspectables, locked doors and fume-collapse handling.
hazard.fume_collapse: Everything goes yellow. Then it goes black.
captain[coughing]: *cough* ...Note to self. Breathe the other stuff.

hazard.fume_collapse.tutorial: You collapsed in the fumes and came round in cleaner air. Keep an eye on the Exposure meter, and step into clean air to recover.
hazard.fume_collapse.title: Fumes

hazard.collapse_hold: The line round your middle goes taut. Somewhere far above, Rook heaves.

then: You never let go of Squawks.

hazard.collapse_hold.say: rook: Got you, Cap'n! Catch your breath and go again. He's still down there!
hazard.collapse_hold.name: Rook (from above)

hazard.collapse_hold.tutorial: Rook hauled you back to the stairs. Follow Squawks's cries, and use clean or light air to recover on the way.
hazard.collapse_hold.title: Rescue

then: The door is shut. Thick yellow wisps curl out from underneath it and pool around your boots.
captain[coughing]: Not a chance. Not until it thins.
You sweep the horizon. Half a mile downwind, a rowboat bobs along behind the ship.
Its passenger spots the glint of the lens and waves enthusiastically.
Far to the east, a royal frigate is still running. Several of her crew appear to be hanging over the stern rail.
A brass telescope on a tripod. The sea is empty again. No more bathtubs. You check twice.

inspect.telescope: A brass telescope on a tripod, trained out to starboard. Nothing but blue.
inspect.rowboat: The ship's rowboat, freshly painted 'G.G.' on the bow in Quill's neatest lettering.
Inside: two oars, a bailing bucket, a clothes-peg, and a small sign reading BACK IN HALF A MILE.
inspect.bathtub_deck: Garrick's 'vessel': an upturned bathtub on claw feet, drying in the sun.
A brass plate on the side reads PROPERTY OF THE HARBOURMASTER, PORT FARTHING. Two of its four screws are missing.
inspect.figurehead: The figurehead used to gaze out to sea with serene oak dignity.
Now she's wrinkling her nose. Permanently. Wick has offered to sand it off. She is having none of it.

inspect.eel_jar.caption: Salty Jim's fermented eel paste, aged in the forepeak since before Wick was born.

inspect.eel_jar: The lid is waxed shut, and then tied shut, and then nailed shut. Jim does not want anyone opening this jar.
inspect.eel_jar_gone: Where the eel paste jar used to stand, there's a clean ring on the table, and a smell that refuses to leave.
inspect.galley_portrait: A portrait of you, looking heroic and slightly cross-eyed. Mags hung it 'so Bob knows he's being watched'.

then: The paint has taken on a yellowish tinge. So has your painted expression.

inspect.lunch_table: The scene of the lunch. A dozen bowls, licked clean, and an empty jar lying on its side like a fallen soldier.
inspect.knitting: Mags's knitting basket: red and cream wool, three needles, and a pattern labelled SMALL JUMPER (PARROT) (FURIOUS).
inspect.shackle: A chain runs from the pillar to Penhallow's ankle. He has polished it. Twice.

then: He has also, you notice, moved as far from your treasure as the chain allows.
Squawks's perch. A few red and blue feathers are still caught in the cracks.
Squawks has asked that nobody mention them. Or look at them. Or think about them.

inspect.perch: Squawks's perch, with a seed tray labelled PRIVATE in beak-scratched capitals.
